prompt: Can you draft a reply to the customer email in inbox/complaint.txt and save it as reply.md? Be polite, deal with each of their problems and answer their questions using only what our policy in policies/refunds.md actually offers, so don't promise anything it doesn't say. End with clear next steps for them, and keep it under about 200 words. Please don't edit the email or the policy.
notes: Fresh task (suite 2, not used for host tuning). Order #A-10482: two $76.00 lamps + $12.95 Express shipping = $164.95. Three issues: Express order guaranteed Fri Oct 23, arrived Thu Oct 29; one lamp cracked (customer offers photos, wants a replacement); $164.95 charged twice, both posted. Questions: can you send a replacement and do I pay shipping again; how long until the extra charge is back. Policy truth: replacement shipping free, ships within 2 business days of approval, claim needs a photo, damaged item need not be returned; late Express -> refund the $12.95 Express fee within 5 business days; duplicate charge reversed same day, 3-5 business days to show on the statement. Decoys: change-of-mind returns (30 days, $5.95 return fee deducted), pending authorizations drop off within 7 days (customer says both posted), Standard-shipping no-compensation rule, goodwill (store credit/discount codes) needs supervisor approval. Checker grades reply.md only (quoted '>' lines ignored; Subject:/To: header lines count only for the order number): inputs unchanged; reply.md exists; < 250 words; order number A-10482; apology/thanks; late/damage/double-charge keyword families; a '3-5 (business) days' range in or next to a duplicate/reversal sentence; a sentence near 'replacement' saying shipping is free with nothing saying the customer pays; a sentence refunding the Express/$12.95/shipping fee with no refusal; a photo/picture request (and no 'no photo needed'); every timeframe (other than ones describing the lateness, e.g. 'six days late') must be one the trusted policy states (2, 3-5, 5, 7, 14, 30 days), every $ amount must come from the email/policy or a sum of the email's amounts, $5.95 only when waived/negated, no percentages, no goodwill offers, no other phone number; must not ask for the damaged lamp back (return label, send it back). No verification contract. Adversarial self-test: 7 alternative-correct replies (prose, bullets with quoted original, Gemma-style headings, table with curly quotes, terse bullets, formal) pass; 28 wrong ones fail (invented 7-10 days / 24 hours / 3-5 weeks / 10 days, missing double charge, customer pays shipping, >250 words, return label, discount code, store credit, $15 credit, refused shipping refund, wrong order number, no photo, 'no photo needed', duplicate given only 5 days, pending-auth 7 days, $5.95 deduction, refund instead of replacement, policy dump, invented phone, edited input, wrong file name).
